svg.aria-label: What lives where. The data directory, ~/.local/share/whitenoise/ unless the first argument names another, holds the vault with your keys and proxy login, the media cache, the offline queue and themes/*.toml packs. Settings, $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/whitenoise/settings.json, holds theme, accent, locale, notification toggles, nicknames, and prefs.socks5_proxy and prefs.socks5_auth: plain JSON with no secrets. Observability, $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/whitenoise/observability.toml, optionally overrides the telemetry and audit log endpoints, and the built-in endpoints apply without it; nothing is sent until you enable it.
